# DATA
## I download the data

```{r}
folder <- "data"
dir.create(folder, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

file_toilets <- file.path(folder, "toilets_amsterdam.geojson")
file_districts    <- file.path(folder, "wijken_amsterdam.geojson")
file_airbnb    <- file.path(folder, "airbnb_amsterdam_listings.csv")
file_hotels    <- file.path(folder, "tourism_amsterdam.geojson")
```


A CELUI QUI DECRIRA LES DONNEES : Pour airbnb elles viennent de ce site internet https://insideairbnb.com/fr/
Les autres viennent de openstreetmap pour les toilettes et quartiers

```{r}
url_airbnb <- paste0(
  "https://data.insideairbnb.com/the-netherlands/north-holland/amsterdam/",
  "2026-09-16/visualisations/listings.csv")

url_toilets <- paste0(
    "https://maps.amsterdam.nl/open_geodata/geojson_lnglat.php",
    "?KAARTLAAG=OPENBARE_TOILETTEN&THEMA=openbare_toiletten")

url_districts <- paste0(
    "https://maps.amsterdam.nl/open_geodata/geojson_lnglat.php",
    "?KAARTLAAG=INDELING_WIJK_EXWATER&THEMA=gebiedsindeling")
```

```{r}
download <- function(url, destination) {
  tryCatch(
    download.file(url, destfile = destination, mode = "wb", quiet = TRUE),
    error = function(e) {
      stop("Échec du téléchargement : ", conditionMessage(e), call. = FALSE)
    }
  )
}
```

```{r}
download(url_airbnb, file_airbnb)
download(url_toilets, file_toilets)
download(url_districts, file_districts)
```

## I get them in the environment

```{r}
districts <- st_read(file_districts, quiet = TRUE)
toilets <- st_read(file_toilets, quiet = TRUE)
airbnb <- read.csv(file_airbnb, stringsAsFactors = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8")
crs_metric <- 28992
hotels <- st_read(file_hotels, quiet = TRUE)
```


## Data processing

```{r}
# Cette fonction matche le point (airbnb, hotel, toilette) avec un quartier
match <- function(points, zones) {
  idx <- st_within(points, zones)
  vapply(idx, function(i) if (length(i) > 0) i[1] else NA_integer_, integer(1))
}

# Nombre de points par quartier
compter <- function(district_id) {
  tabulate(district_id[!is.na(district_id)], nbins = nrow(districts))
}

# Distance (m) de chaque point à l'élément le plus proche de `cible`
distance_plus_proche <- function(points, cible) {
  i <- st_nearest_feature(points, cible)
  as.numeric(st_distance(points, cible[i, ], by_element = TRUE))
}
```


```{r}
# For the district dataset
districts <- st_transform(districts, crs_metric)
districts$surface_km2 <- as.numeric(st_area(districts)) / 1e6

# For the toilet dataset
names(toilets) <- c("type", "cost", "opening_days",
                      "schedules", "location", "picture", "categorie",
                      "geometry")

coords <- st_coordinates(toilets)
toilets <- toilets[which(coords[, "X"] != 0 & coords[, "Y"] != 0), ]
toilets <- st_transform(toilets, crs_metric)
toilets$district_id <- match(toilets, districts)

# For the hotel dataset
hotels <- st_transform(hotels, crs_metric) %>%
  select(id, name, geometry)
hotels$district_id <- match(hotels, districts)

# For the airbnb dataset
airbnb <- st_as_sf(airbnb, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)
airbnb <- st_transform(airbnb, crs_metric)
airbnb$district_id <- match(airbnb, districts)
```

# Analysis

```{r}
# --- Districts overview ------------------------------------
districts$n_hotels    <- compter(hotels$district_id)
districts$n_airbnb    <- compter(airbnb$district_id)
districts$n_toilets <- compter(toilets$district_id)

districts$hotels_km2    <- districts$n_hotels    / districts$surface_km2
districts$airbnb_km2    <- districts$n_airbnb    / districts$surface_km2
districts$toilets_km2 <- districts$n_toilets / districts$surface_km2
districts$hotels_par_toilette <- ifelse(districts$n_toilets > 0,
                                     districts$n_hotels / districts$n_toilets, NA)

# Lien hôtels <-> toilettes : distance à la toilette la plus proche
hotels$dist_toilette_m <- distance_plus_proche(hotels, toilets)
airbnb$dist_toilette_m <- distance_plus_proche(airbnb, toilets)

par_wijk <- function(valeurs, district_id, fonction) {
  as.numeric(tapply(valeurs, factor(district_id, levels = seq_len(nrow(districts))),
                    fonction))
}
districts$dist_med_hotel_m    <- par_wijk(hotels$dist_toilette_m, hotels$district_id, median)
districts$part_hotels_proches <- par_wijk(hotels$dist_toilette_m <= 300,
                                       hotels$district_id, mean)
districts$dist_med_airbnb_m   <- par_wijk(airbnb$dist_toilette_m, airbnb$district_id, median)

cat("\nDistance médiane hôtel -> toilette la plus proche :",
    round(median(hotels$dist_toilette_m)), "m\n")
cat("Part des hôtels à moins de", 300, "m d'une toilette :",
    round(100 * mean(hotels$dist_toilette_m <= 300)), "%\n")
cat("Corrélation de Spearman hôtels/km2 ~ toilets/km2 :",
    round(cor(districts$hotels_km2, districts$toilets_km2, method = "spearman"), 2), "\n")
```

```{r}
# --- Cartes ------------------------------------------------------
# Échelle de couleurs en racine carrée (les densités sont très asymétriques).
# L'argument s'appelle `transform` depuis ggplot2 3.5.0, `trans` avant.
echelle <- function(nom) {
  args <- list(name = nom, option = "magma", direction = -1, na.value = "grey90")
  if (packageVersion("ggplot2") >= "3.5.0") args$transform <- "sqrt" else args$trans <- "sqrt"
  do.call(scale_fill_viridis_c, args)
}

# Carte 1 : densité d'hôtels + toilets
carte1 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = districts, aes(fill = hotels_km2), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = toilets, color = "#1b6ca8", size = 0.7, alpha = 0.8) +
  echelle("Hôtels / km²") +
  labs(title = "Densité d'hôtels et toilettes publiques – Amsterdam",
       subtitle = "Points bleus : toilettes publiques",
       caption = "Hôtels : © OpenStreetMap contributors · Toilettes : Gemeente Amsterdam") +
  theme_minimal()

# Carte 2 : densité d'annonces Airbnb
carte2 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = districts, aes(fill = airbnb_km2), color = "white", linewidth = 0.2) +
  echelle("Annonces / km²") +
  labs(title = "Densité d'annonces Airbnb – Amsterdam",
       caption = "Inside Airbnb (CC BY 4.0)") +
  theme_minimal()

# Carte 3 : hôtels selon la distance à la toilette publique la plus proche
hotels$classe_dist <- cut(hotels$dist_toilette_m,
                          breaks = c(-Inf, 150, 300, 500, Inf),
                          labels = c("< 150 m", paste0("150 – ", 300, " m"),
                                     paste0(300, " – 500 m"), "> 500 m"))
carte3 <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = districts, fill = "grey95", color = "grey75", linewidth = 0.2) +
  geom_sf(data = toilets, shape = 17, color = "grey20", size = 0.9) +
  geom_sf(data = hotels, aes(color = classe_dist), size = 1.4) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Distance à la\ntoilette la plus proche",
                        option = "plasma", end = 0.9) +
  labs(title = "Hôtels et accès aux toilettes publiques",
       subtitle = "Triangles gris : toilettes publiques") +
  theme_minimal()

print(carte1)
print(carte2)
print(carte3)
```
